direction.situation: Outside on a rainy Colombo roadside beside Kasun's small food three-wheeler; Anudi has just taken the phone Kasun returned and is about to answer an incoming call.
direction.people: Anudi (on screen): standing left, cream blouse and teal skirt, phone in her right hand, umbrella and bag on her left; she feels warm and grateful, then briefly interrupted. Kasun (off camera this clip): present at the stall in the right background, a friendly presence that just stepped away; his return of the phone created a quiet connection. Father (voice only, not seen): urgent and expectant, heard through the call.

flow.text: Anudi holds the phone up in her right hand, glances down at the screen, then lifts it to her right ear with a small, familiar smile.

flow.how: warm, habitual greeting with a small smile, phone pressed to her ear
flow.listener: the call connects; a brief electronic click as the line opens

flow.text: After she finishes the greeting she holds the phone at her ear and waits, eyes steady but expectant, rain on the umbrella visible at frame edge.

direction.camera: medium close-up (head and shoulders) at eye level from the road side; locked-off on a tripod, 65mm lens.
direction.sound: light rain on umbrella and pavement, distant traffic, phone connection click; no music.
